feature: SharedChannel background ORCA OOB ownership and latest-value fan-out

scope.ownership: one endpoint worker owns Health, keepalive, ORCA OOB and business streams on each HTTP/2 connection
scope.fan_out: multiple per-endpoint generation watches receive independent owned clones of the latest report
lifecycle: shutdown remains observable by retained watches
scope.backpressure: periodic gauges coalesce to the latest generation instead of accumulating an unbounded per-subscriber queue

reference.implementation: grpc-core OobBackendMetricWatcher and the existing netz SharedChannel endpoint-owner and Health watch design
reference.description: src/core/load_balancing/oob_backend_metric.cc plus netz src/grpc/channel/shared worker, membership and stream owner modules

implementation.configuration: SharedChannelOptions.orca_oob is validated and deep-copied, including request metadata and serialized request-cost selection
implementation.admission: enabling OOB creates endpoint connection demand without requiring an application RPC
implementation.worker: starts and polls OOB without a second socket reader, resumes partial request output, preserves business capacity accounting, and retries with channel backoff
implementation.tracker: stable refcounted tracker outlives worker retirement, clones reports on read, preserves watch cursor after OOM, and publishes explicit lifecycle states
implementation.isolation: ORCA UNIMPLEMENTED retires only telemetry; business RPCs remain admitted on the same connection
implementation.goaway: no replacement OOB stream is opened after peer GOAWAY; transport replacement owns the next admission

results.local_reconnect: two independent watchers received report 0.25, business unary completed, transport was replaced, and report 0.75 arrived from the reconnected endpoint
results.unimplemented: telemetry reached UNIMPLEMENTED while a same-connection business unary still completed
results.official_forward_matrix: 9/9 build steps passed over h2c and TLS with shared_orca=oob-background+fanout while the original exact keepalive ACK gate remained enabled

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC SharedChannel ORCA' -Dtest-filter='gRPC shared ORCA tracker' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -Dtest-filter='gRPC SharedChannel ORCA' -Dtest-filter='gRPC shared ORCA tracker' --summary all
remaining_gap: The transport and fan-out lifecycle are covered. Cross-endpoint aggregation and load-balancing decisions remain explicit application policy rather than being silently inferred from ORCA metrics.
